title: fix(cli): os init / os create emit overrides.vitest so new projects install on npm 10
body:
Fixes #23805

Clause-②: no

`os init` (all three templates) and `os create plugin` now emit `"overrides": { "vitest": "~4.0.0" }`, built from `SCAFFOLD_VITEST_RANGE` through one new export, `SCAFFOLD_NPM_OVERRIDES`. The scaffolded project now installs on npm 10, the npm that Node 22 bundles. `scripts/sync-scaffold-emission-policy.mjs` gains an `overrides.vitest` `POLICY_STAMPS` row, so the blank template's override is now generated from the same constant instead of being kept by hand. The template file's bytes do not change, because it already reads `~4.0.0`.

## Upstream re-measured first, as the card asks

Read 2026-10-16T06:46Z with `npm view`:

- `vitest` dist-tags: `V4` = `4.1.12`, `latest` = `5.0.5`.
- `vitest@4.1.12` peers `"@vitest/browser-webdriverio": "^4.1.11"` (optional). Every other `@vitest/*` peer is pinned to exactly `4.1.12`.
- `@vitest/browser-webdriverio` has no `4.1.12`. Its newest 4.x is `4.1.11`, which peers `"vitest": "4.1.11"`.
- So the contradiction is still live upstream. The range itself is not changed here.

## Every emission site, with its verdict

Measured 2026-10-16T06:57Z. Each manifest was installed in an empty directory with a fresh `--cache`, against the published `18.0.0-next.2`. "Before" is today's `main` emission.

| Site | declares `vitest` directly | before, npm 10.9.9 | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| `os init -t app` (`init.ts`, `renderScaffoldPackageJson`) | no | exit 1, `edgesOut` | in scope: emits the override |
| `os init -t plugin` (same renderer) | `~4.0.0` | exit 1, `edgesOut` | in scope: emits the override |
| `os init -t empty` (same renderer) | no | exit 1, `edgesOut` | in scope: emits the override |
| `os create plugin` standalone (`create.ts`) | `~4.0.0` | exit 0 | emits the override (card criterion; keeps it equal to the declaration) |
| `os create plugin --in-repo` | `~4.0.0` | n/a (pnpm workspace member) | no override: npm reads `overrides` only from the root manifest and pnpm never reads it, so here it would do nothing |
| `create-objectstack` blank template | `~4.0.0` | already overridden (landed earlier) | now stamped by the new `POLICY_STAMPS` row |

`os create` has one template (`plugin`), and `os init` has three (`app`, `plugin`, `empty`), all rendered through `renderScaffoldPackageJson`. No other `packages/cli` code writes a scaffold `package.json`.

### Why `-t app` and `-t empty` too, against the card's plugin-only criterion

The dispatch assumed that a site emitting no `vitest` needs no override. The measurement above shows otherwise: `-t app` and `-t empty` crash the same way, because what all three templates share is `@objectstack/cli` in `devDependencies`, and its closure carries optional `vitest` peers (`@objectstack/metadata-core` peers `^4.0.0`, better-auth peers `^2 || ^3 || ^4`). `-t app` is also the docs.objectos.ai quickstart's command, measured failing 3 of 3 in the card's thread. `os create plugin` has no `@objectstack/cli` in its closure, which is why it installed without the override.

## The installs after the change

Each emitted manifest was produced by driving the real CLI (`tsx bin/run-dev.js init NAME -t T --no-install` and `create plugin NAME`), then installed in an empty directory with a fresh `--cache`:

| manifest | npm 10.9.9 | npm 11.21.1 | vitest in the tree |
|---|---|---|---|
| `os init -t app` | exit 0 | exit 0 | none |
| `os init -t plugin` | exit 0 | exit 0 | one copy, 4.0.18 |
| `os init -t empty` | exit 0 | exit 0 | none |
| `os create plugin` | exit 0 | exit 0 | one copy, 4.0.18 |

## Cost, measured

On an emitted `-t app` with the override (npm 10.9.9):

- A later bare `npm install -D vitest` is refused with `EOVERRIDE: Override for vitest@* conflicts with direct dependency`.
- `npm install -D vitest@~4.0.0` installs (vitest 4.0.18).

The refusal is loud and names the conflict; without the override the project could not install at all. The changeset gives the one-line fix. `"$vitest"` is not used: it needs a direct dependency, and two of the three `os init` templates have none.

## The stamp row

`POLICY_STAMPS` gains `{ key: 'overrides.vitest', block: 'overrides', field: 'vitest', constant: 'SCAFFOLD_VITEST_RANGE' }`. The engine already locates any `"BLOCK": { … }` object and one field inside it, so no engine change was needed. The self-test:

- Every fixture template carries `overrides.vitest`.
- Battery B now parses both vitest stamps, instead of a substring check that one stale copy could still pass.
- New battery J drifts the override alone while `devDependencies.vitest` agrees. It checks that `--check` exits 1 naming `overrides.vitest`, that the agreeing key is not blamed, that the rewrite touches only that span byte for byte, and that a template dropping the `overrides` block exits 1 naming it.
- Roster floor 9 → 10.

`--check` on the real template, before and after a mutation (through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which restores and checks the blob hash):

- The blank template's `overrides.vitest` was mutated to `^4.1.0`. `--check` then exits 1 with `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/package.json: overrides.vitest is "^4.1.0" but the policy declares "~4.0.0"`.
- Restored: blob `1bbbff43ce0f` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Control: the same mutation under `main`'s script (`1ecb08a1c`, no row) exits 0 (`2 carrier(s) emit the shared policy`). So on `main`, an override drift that npm refuses with `EOVERRIDE` passed the gate.

## Pins

`packages/cli/test/scaffold-npm-overrides.test.ts` is a unit-tier file. Every expectation is derived from the exported constants, with no literal range:

- every `os init` template and `os create plugin` (standalone) emit `overrides` equal to `SCAFFOLD_NPM_OVERRIDES`, whose `vitest` is `SCAFFOLD_VITEST_RANGE`;
- every override that names a direct dependency equals that dependency's spec (npm `EOVERRIDE`);
- `--in-repo` emits no `overrides`;
- a control checks that the harvest is non-empty and that the equality case ranges over the two manifests that declare vitest.

Ablation, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each leg mutates, runs the file, restores, and proves the restored blob equals HEAD:

- Deleting the override from `renderScaffoldPackageJson` fails the 3 `os init` cases (3 failed / 8 passed).
- Deleting it from `create.ts` fails `os create plugin` (1 failed / 10 passed).
- Forcing it on in-repo fails the in-repo case (1 failed / 10 passed).

## Verification

All results below are at head `f8d18b092` unless a line says otherwise. Exit codes were captured before any pipe.

- Gate union: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` names 85 commands, derived from merge base `43567a8fc`. Run at `f8d18b092`: **85 of 85 exit 0**. `--ran` reconciliation: exit 0, `85 derived, 85 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- An earlier pass of the union, at `e521b5709`, found one real red: `check:cross-package-test-inputs` exit 1. A comment in `template-consistency.test.ts` spelled the stamp script's repo path, which the gate reads as a cross-package input. The comment was reworded in `f8d18b092`.
- `node scripts/sync-scaffold-emission-policy.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, 60 assertions, 10 batteries. `--check`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2` over the 23 non-e2e test files that import `commands/init` or `commands/create`, the new pin included: exit 0, **22 files / 501 tests passed**, at `d8a9a54f3`. The later commits touch no `packages/cli` file.
  - `test/generate-stack-reach.test.ts` is in the `integration` project. That tier and the nightly `scaffold-emission-policy.e2e.test.ts` are declared to CI.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck` OK), at `d8a9a54f3`.
- `pnpm --filter create-objectstack test`: exit 0, 18 files / 275 tests. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the five changed source and test files: exit 0. The repo-wide lint run belongs to the `Lint & Repo Gates` check-run.

## Acceptance notes

- Finding, not fixed here: the published skill's copy-paste manifest has the same crash. This is `skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md`, the "Complete Working Example" `package.json` fence (`@objectstack/cli ^17.0.0`, no override). Its `npm install` on npm 10.9.9 exits 1 with `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')`, and with `overrides.vitest: ~4.0.0` added it exits 0 (measured 2026-10-16T08:10Z). `skills/**` is a governed surface, and the stamp script's `PUBLISHED_RESTATEMENTS` leg only reads that fence and checks only `devDependencies.typescript`. So the fix is a hand edit landed the governed way, and adding `overrides.vitest` to that row's `keys` comes with it. This is reported for the seat to file, not filed from this PR.
- The Docker image (#23801) and the optional `vitest` peers of `plugin-auth` / `metadata-core` (#23806) are untouched; both remain open. The blank template's override from the PR for #23788 is unchanged in bytes and is now generated.
- `create-objectstack`'s shipped bytes do not change (`files` is `dist`, and the template is byte-identical), so the changeset names `@objectstack/cli` alone.
